header.title: Sécurité Web & Expertise OWASP
header.subtitle: Conception d'applications étanches et audit de vulnérabilités selon le standard international OWASP Top 10.

owaspTop10.title: Broken Access Control
owaspTop10.description: Failles de contrôle d'accès permettant à un utilisateur d'agir hors de ses permissions.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Mise en place de middlewares RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) stricts, vérification systématique de l'ID utilisateur côté serveur.

owaspTop10.title: Cryptographic Failures
owaspTop10.description: Exposition de données sensibles transmises ou stockées sans chiffrement approprié.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Hachage bcrypt/Argon2 pour les mots de passe, HTTPS/TLS 1.3 obligatoire, chiffrement AES-256 des données sensibles.

owaspTop10.title: Injection (SQL, NoSQL, Command)
owaspTop10.description: Introduction d'instructions malveillantes via des entrées utilisateur non assainies.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Utilisation exclusive de requêtes préparées via Prisma ORM et validation stricte des entrées (Zod/Joi).

owaspTop10.title: Insecure Design
owaspTop10.description: Défauts d'architecture et absence de modélisation des menaces dès la conception.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Prise en compte du 'Security by Design', limitation de débit (Rate-Limiting), défense en profondeur.

owaspTop10.title: Security Misconfiguration
owaspTop10.description: Services mal configurés, en-têtes de sécurité manquants ou messages d'erreur verbeux.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Implémentation de Helmet.js, Content Security Policy (CSP), désactivation des en-têtes Server X-Powered-By.

owaspTop10.title: Identification & Auth Failures
owaspTop10.description: Authentification faible sujette aux attaques par force brute ou vol de session.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Jetons JWT sécurisés transmis en cookies HTTP-Only SameSite=Strict, protection anti-brute force par IP.

securityChecklist.title: Validation & Sanitisation des Entrées
securityChecklist.desc: Validation côté serveur de tous les formulaires et paramètres d'URL

securityChecklist.title: Gestion Sécurisée des Sessions JWT
securityChecklist.desc: Cookies HTTP-Only, rotation des refresh tokens, expiration courte

securityChecklist.title: Protection Anti-CSRF & SameSite
securityChecklist.desc: Protection contre les attaques de falsification de requête intersites

securityChecklist.title: Limitation de Débit (Rate Limiting)
securityChecklist.desc: Contrôle des requêtes par minute sur les API sensibles (/login, /register)

securityChecklist.title: Audit & Tests d'Intrusion Applicatifs
securityChecklist.desc: Revue de code axée sécurité et scanning de vulnérabilités automatisé

header.title: Web Security & OWASP Expertise
header.subtitle: Designing bulletproof web applications and vulnerability audits adhering to international OWASP Top 10 standards.

owaspTop10.title: Broken Access Control
owaspTop10.description: Access control flaws allowing users to act outside of their intended permissions.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Enforcement of strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) middleware and systematic server-side user ID verification.

owaspTop10.title: Cryptographic Failures
owaspTop10.description: Exposure of sensitive data transmitted or stored without appropriate encryption.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Bcrypt/Argon2 password hashing, mandatory HTTPS/TLS 1.3, and AES-256 encryption for sensitive payloads.

owaspTop10.title: Injection (SQL, NoSQL, Command)
owaspTop10.description: Malicious code injection via un-sanitized user inputs.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Exclusive use of prepared queries via Prisma ORM and strict server-side schema validation (Zod/Joi).

owaspTop10.title: Insecure Design
owaspTop10.description: Architectural flaws and lack of threat modeling during initial software design.
owaspTop10.mitigation: 'Security by Design' implementation, API Rate-Limiting, and defense-in-depth architecture.

owaspTop10.title: Security Misconfiguration
owaspTop10.description: Misconfigured services, missing security headers, or verbose server error stack traces.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Helmet.js integration, Content Security Policy (CSP), and disabling X-Powered-By headers.

owaspTop10.title: Identification & Auth Failures
owaspTop10.description: Weak authentication vulnerable to brute-force attacks or session hijacking.
owaspTop10.mitigation: Hardened JWT tokens delivered via HTTP-Only SameSite=Strict cookies and IP rate limiting.

securityChecklist.title: Input Validation & Sanitization
securityChecklist.desc: Server-side schema validation for all forms and URL parameters

securityChecklist.title: Secure JWT Session Management
securityChecklist.desc: HTTP-Only cookies, refresh token rotation, short expiration

securityChecklist.title: Anti-CSRF & SameSite Shield
securityChecklist.desc: Protection against cross-site request forgery attacks

securityChecklist.title: API Rate Limiting
securityChecklist.desc: Request throttling on sensitive API endpoints (/login, /register)

securityChecklist.title: Application Security Audit & Penetration Testing
securityChecklist.desc: Security-focused code reviews and automated vulnerability scans
